useCases.value: MAS TRM §11.1.1 requires FI boards to be satisfied with resilience outcomes; automated RTO/RPO reconciliation is auditor-friendly evidence.

useCases.title: NERC CIP-008-6 R1 incident response plan — evidence of activation and review
useCases.value: CIP-008-6 R1 requires an IR plan and evidence of activation / annual review. Automated tracking catches drift before a CIP enforcement action.

useCases.title: Petroleumsforskriften §11 — emergency preparedness drill evidence
useCases.value: §11 requires demonstrable preparedness for emergency situations; drill cadence and activation records are auditor-facing evidence.

useCases.title: Sikkerhetsloven §6-1 — preventive control effectiveness across classified systems
useCases.value: §6-1 requires systematic preventive measures; effectiveness KPIs make the §6-1 duty continuously measurable.

useCases.title: NZISM §16.1.32 — user authentication strength & MFA coverage
useCases.value: §16.1.32 requires agencies to deploy authentication commensurate with classification; continuous MFA KPIs evidence the control.

useCases.title: PIPL Art.51 — information-security measures across PRC personal-data systems
useCases.value: PIPL Art.51 mandates information-security management; the UC gives data processors Chinese-authority-facing evidence of Art.51 measures.

useCases.title: QCB §4.1 — cyber-risk register evidence with treatment progress
useCases.value: §4.1 requires FIs to identify and manage cyber risk; overdue-risk evidence is hard to fake and is directly auditor-facing.

useCases.title: SA PDPL Art. 6 — processing-purpose and lawful-basis evidence
useCases.value: SA PDPL Art. 6 requires a lawful basis for each processing activity; the UC produces direct evidence of alignment or gaps.

useCases.title: SWIFT CSCF 6.1 — malware protection across the SWIFT secure zone
useCases.value: CSCF 6.1 is a mandatory control; continuous coverage checks produce annual KYC-SA attestation evidence on demand.

useCases.title: Swiss nFADP Art.7 — privacy-by-design checkpoints in the SDLC
useCases.value: nFADP Art.7 explicitly requires privacy-by-design; the UC ties the statutory duty to measurable SDLC KPIs.

useCases.title: SYSC 4.1 organisational requirements — role-population and responsibilities map

useCases.title: NESA T3.5 cryptographic controls — key-age & HSM inventory evidence
useCases.value: T3.5 requires effective cryptographic key-management; key-age metrics expose drift from the control.

useCases.value: §14 (mirroring GDPR Art.22) requires safeguards for automated individual decisions; a low review rate triggers an immediate DPO review.

useCases.value: §3 establishes the operator's general duty of care; continuous monitoring of recurring obligations is good stewardship evidence.

useCases.value: §5-2 mandates an annual internal security review; a simple overdue-check prevents long silent gaps.

useCases.title: NZISM §12.4 — policy documentation freshness and approval state
useCases.value: §12.4 requires policies to be kept current; stale-policy metrics are direct GCSB-facing evidence.

useCases.title: SA PDPL Art. 29 — cross-border transfer inventory and legal-basis evidence
useCases.value: Art. 29 requires a documented basis for every outbound transfer; continuous inventory is superior to point-in-time attestations.
